title: Moment of Parting
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji gazed at the direction where Chen Ling faded away, gripping the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand. He knew that although the path ahead would be lonely, that warmth would forever accompany him.

text.content: As dawn broke, mist swirled atop the mountain peak. Two figures stood side by side, yet a silent melancholy of impending separation permeated the air. Chen Ji looked at the young woman before him, his heart filled with mixed emotions. Chen Ling's form had already begun to grow translucent, as if she might dissipate into the heavens and earth at any moment.

Chen Ling smiled faintly, her smile holding no sorrow, only a tranquil peace after experiencing the vicissitudes of life. She gently reached out, her fingertips touching Chen Ji's forehead, and a wisp of golden light spilled from her body, flowing slowly into Chen Ji's form.

dialogue.content: These are all the insights I have gained over these years, now entirely transferred to you. They will aid you in walking further along this path.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a warm yet powerful force surge into his body, representing Chen Ling's thousand years of accumulated wisdom. He closed his eyes, letting this force flow through him. In an instant, countless images flashed through his mind—Chen Ling's contemplation in loneliness, her insights when facing heaven and earth, her profound understanding of life and destiny.

dialogue.content: These insights... are too precious. I... I don't know what to say.

text.content: The golden light gradually faded, and Chen Ling's form became increasingly illusory. She stepped back gently, her gaze filled with tenderness and reluctance, yet also a resolute sense of release.

choice.prompt: As separation looms, how should Chen Ji face this farewell?

choices.description: Chen Ji decided to offer Chen Ling his most sincere blessing, allowing her to depart in peace. Their bond would not be severed by separation.
choices.visible_reward: Receiving all of Chen Ling's inherited insights, combat power greatly enhanced
choices.risk_hint: May sink into grief and affect judgment

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, striving to calm the turmoil in his heart, and slowly began to speak.

choices.description: Chen Ji wanted to try to retain Chen Ling, seeking a way for her to stay. He was unwilling to easily abandon this bond.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best moment for parting
choices.visible_reward: May discover a new way of coexistence
choices.risk_hint: Forcibly retaining her could lead to mutual destruction

text.content: Chen Ji reached out, wanting to grasp something, only to find his fingers passing through Chen Ling's illusory form.

choices.description: Chen Ji and Chen Ling made a promise that no matter how far apart, someday they would meet again. This promise would become the driving force for each of them to move forward.
choices.visible_cost: Need to bear the responsibility of the promise
choices.risk_hint: Whether the promise can be fulfilled remains unknown

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze grew firm, as if he had found the direction for his journey.

dialogue.content: Go, pursue your own path. No matter how many dangers lie ahead, I will remember the time we walked side by side.

text.content: Chen Ling's form grew increasingly illusory, as if she would at any moment merge with heaven and earth. However, just then, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a faint glow, and an strange power spilled from it, slowly flowing into Chen Ji's body.

choice.prompt: Facing this sudden awakening of power, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Chen Ji chose to embrace this power, letting it merge with Chen Ling's insights to complete his final transformation.
choices.visible_cost: Need to endure the risk of power impact
choices.visible_reward: Combat power rises to mid-level Breaker, gaining complete independent personality
choices.risk_hint: The power fusion process may involve intense pain

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, letting that power surge through his body.

choices.description: Chen Ji chose to carefully guide this power, avoiding deviation due to impatience. Steady progress is paramount.
choices.visible_reward: Stronger foundation, greater potential for future development
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best breakthrough timing

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and began to carefully guide that power.

Golden light circulated within Chen Ji, perfectly fusing with the insights passed by Chen Ling. His aura began to change, an unprecedented power surging within him. That was the aura of a Breaker, true independence and strength.

dialogue.content: I feel it... an unprecedented completeness. So this is what independence feels like.

text.content: When the light faded, Chen Ling's form had become almost invisible. She turned around, casting one final glance at Chen Ji, her eyes filled with relief and reluctance.

choice.prompt: At this final moment, what does Chen Ji want to say to Chen Ling?

choices.description: Chen Ji solemnly bid farewell to Chen Ling, promising to continue their respective journeys.
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete independent personality, embark on a new journey

text.content: Chen Ji lightly clasped his hands, offering Chen Ling his final salute.

choices.description: Chen Ji promised Chen Ling that no matter where she was, he would find her. This obsession would become his driving force.
choices.visible_cost: May require a very long time to achieve
choices.visible_reward: Gain spiritual sustenance, the path ahead no longer confusing
choices.risk_hint: The future is full of unknowns

text.content: A determined light burned in Chen Ji's eyes.

dialogue.content: Chen Ling, take care. No matter the ends of the earth, I will never forget these years. May your path ahead be smooth, and may you achieve your heart's desires.

text.content: Chen Ling's form dissipated completely, transforming into countless golden specks of light drifting toward the heavens. Chen Ji stood there, watching those specks gradually disappear, his heart holding both the sorrow of parting and anticipation for the future.

Just then, Chen Ji felt the power within him reach its peak. That was the aura of a mid-level Breaker, the crystallization of Chen Ling's complete insights merged with the power of the Tianji Record Fragment. He opened his eyes, his pupils gleaming with sharp light, as if he could see through all falsehood in the world.

After the separation, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented coexistence of emptiness and completeness. The bond that once supported him had now transformed into the warmest and most steadfast force deep within his heart. He was no longer the youth who needed to rely on others, but a truly independent and powerful Breaker.

The morning wind blew past, lifting Chen Ji's robes. He turned to gaze at the mountain below, where the Tianqing Sect lay—his new battlefield. Ling Yuan's threat had not been resolved, the ambitions of the Demonic Path still burned, and he was ready. Chen Ji took a deep breath and stepped forward, the morning light stretching his shadow long, as if it would extend to the ends of the world. The road ahead was long, but in his eyes, there was already a clear direction.
